discussion: A cyber security strategy articulates an organisation’s vision, guiding principles, objectives and priorities for cyber security, typically over a five-year period. In addition, a cyber security strategy may also cover an organisation’s threat environment, cyber security initiatives or investments the organisation plans to make as part of its cyber security program. Without a cyber security strategy, an organisation risks failing to adequately plan for and manage security and business risks within their organisation.
section_path: Development and maintenance of cyber security documentation
title: A cyber security strategy is developed, implemented and maintained.
